institution_waivers.note: Direct Entry: (a) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in the subject of specialization/teaching subject and one (1) other relevant subject; (b) NCE merit in the subject of specialization/teaching subject and one (1) other relevant subject. UTME: five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Christian Religious Studies and three (3) relevant subjects at a sitting or four (4) at two sittings; 'O' Level credit passes in Mathematics and Economics required for teaching option in Economics; 'O' Level credit pass in Government or History and pass in Mathematics required for Science and Social Studies; 'O' Level credit passes in Literature in English and two other Arts subjects required for English Language option. UTME subjects: relevant subjects for the teaching options — Literature in English for English Language, Mathematics and Economics for Economics, Government and History for Political Science or Social Studies.
